dataset: Anthropic HH-RLHF (MIT license), official GitHub release

transformer_reward_model.reason: Environment provides ~1.5 shared CPUs and 6 GB RAM; installing a transformer stack (~2 GB) and fine-tuning on tens of thousands of pairs would take many hours. The guaranteed deliverable (logistic preference model on engineered + TF-IDF features) was run instead; no transformer number is reported or implied.

limitations: No annotator IDs in the public release: true inter-annotator agreement cannot be computed.
Gold-set labels are single-analyst adjudications operationalised through documented rules, not independent human re-annotation.
The lexicon is a surface proxy for harmful content, not ground truth about harm.
Word counts use whitespace tokenisation, not a model tokenizer.
